article.title: Vocabulary quiz: pick the correct synonym
article.description: Quiz format: 'Which word is closest in meaning to HAPPY? a) Content  b) Furious  c) Exhausted  d) Confused' Answer: a) Content. Teaching point: 'content' means satisfied/happy with one's situation — a common IELTS/vocabulary-test synonym pairing.
article.content: Quiz format: 'Which word is closest in meaning to HAPPY? a) Content  b) Furious  c) Exhausted  d) Confused' Answer: a) Content. Teaching point: 'content' means satisfied/happy with one's situation — a common IELTS/vocabulary-test synonym pairing.

generated.caption: Think 'happy' is the only word? 🤔 Boost your vocabulary! Today's quiz word is 'content'. This means you're satisfied and happy with your situation. It's a great synonym to know for IELTS! For example: 'She felt content after a productive day.' Save this tip & follow @theenglishvault for daily English lessons!
generated.script:
Ye dono words mein confusion hota hai na? Happy ka ek sahi synonym kya hai jo IELTS mein bhi aata hai?

Toh dekho, happy ka ek bahut common aur useful synonym hai "content". Iska matlab hota hai ki aap apni situation se satisfied ho, ya phir khush ho. You are content when you feel satisfied with what you have. Yeh ek bahut important word hai vocabulary tests ke liye.

Toh ab samajh aaya ki happy ka ek accurate synonym "content" kaise hai? Yaad rakhna, "content" means being satisfied or happy with your situation.

Comment mein batao aapko ye synonym pehle se pata tha ya nahi! Aur aise hi English tips ke liye The English Vault ko follow karo.

slides.body: When you're happy and satisfied with your current situation, the word 'content' perfectly describes that feeling. It means being pleased and accepting of what you have, often implying a sense of peaceful happiness rather than excitement. For instance, 'She was content with her simple life in the countryside, needing nothing more.' This word is frequently tested in vocabulary quizzes and exams like IELTS as a close synonym for 'happy'.
